$comment: Shared notification-kind vocabulary fixture (PR-6 FE regression guards). Single source both sides assert against: backend models/notification.py::NOTIFICATION_KIND_VALUES (Postgres enum notification_kind) and the frontend mirror features/notifications/api/notificationsApi.ts::NOTIFICATION_KINDS. Asserted from apps/frontend/tests/unit/contracts/catalogMirrors.test.ts and, since MAL-2b, from apps/backend/tests/unit/test_catalog_contracts.py — the one-sided guard is why vuln_sla_breach (X1) reached production rendering a raw i18n key. Order matters: it mirrors the enum declaration order.
